The '''hyperspace nullifier''' was a [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] designed millions of years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by the [[K'kybak]] species who lived on the planet [[Seymarti V]]. The weapon was capable of controlling [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel, potentially locking out populations of entire planets from being able to access hyperspace. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the weapon was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] astrocartographer [[Essio Galassian]], who attempted to make it work for the Empire. However, in an attempt to stop Galassian, a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] squad led by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] destroyed the weapon along with the entire planet it was located on.<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">[[Honor Among Thieves]]</ref>
